captureBoundary.normalMaintenance: Explicit HOME/PATH/CI/GRAFT_NO_GITIGNORE environment; ambient inheritance disabled except deep builds, notifications and systemctl.
captureBoundary.caveat: A bound is not a confidentiality proof. Pathful output and inherited deep-build environment need separate reviewed capture evidence.

remaining: Review transitive systemd/process/Graft/root-discovery implementations; the five direct Refs files are now reviewed only at source level.
Bind exact executable and external repository identities for any runtime experiment.
Review actual reachable entrypoint graph and emitted runtime outputs.
No approved signed remote or shadow evidence is supplied by this review.

schemaReview.manifest: Strict excess-property decoders, unique member names, version/theme literals, HOME-prefixed default root, and fixed workspaceLink. URL is only a nonempty string; this does not pin remote identity.
schemaReview.paths: Member names exclude slash. onlyDir rejects absolute slash paths, parent-directory segments and control characters. Timer inputs delegate to SystemdUnitPath; its transitive implementation is not reviewed here.
schemaReview.status: Timestamp and workspace output are strings; root is nonempty, exit codes integers, member coverage optional. Shape validation alone does not make captures safe or evidence authoritative.
schemaReview.errors: ReferenceWorkspaceError carries path, message and optional defect including stack. Error schemas do not establish redaction.
schemaReview.exports: Barrel re-exports command, errors, schemas and service; no additional operations are introduced by the barrel itself.
